GST Collections Surge 22.9% to ₹2.31 Lakh Crore in October

India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenues reached ₹2.31 lakh crore in October, marking a 22.9% year-on-year increase. This growth was driven by a significant 42.2% rise in imports and strong domestic transactions. One report noted net GST collections grew 25.6% to ₹2.03 trillion, representing the fastest growth for fiscal year 2027.
